dimensions.name: Silent planning-model swap on runtime-scoped deployments
dimensions.review_prompt: The _default_planning_model change (swe_af/execution/schemas.py:756-809) silently replaces the sonnet fallback with the runtime's native base default (deepseek-v4-flash-0731 or gpt-5.3-codex/gpt-5.5) for any deployment that sets SWE_DEFAULT_RUNTIME=open_code or codex without SWE_DEFAULT_MODEL or AI_MODEL. Verify that this breaking change is guarded by an explicit opt-in, a deprecation notice, or a migration guide; if none exist, flag it as a release-risk to existing Docker deployments.
